articles.title: LGBTQ+ people go into hiding in Senegal as hundreds are arrested
articles.description:
At least 320 people detained for ‘acts against nature’ after law criminalising homosexuality toughened, HRW reports
Mass arrests, forced HIV testing and barriers to legal representation are part of an escalating crackdown against LGBTQ+ people in Senegal, according to a new report.
More than 320 individuals have been arrested and detained on allegations of “acts against nature” since February, according to HIV Justice Network, an organisation quoted in the Human Rights Watch (HRW) report. Among these, at least 84 were charged with “voluntary HIV transmission”, solely on the basis of their HIV status.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Zimbabwean author Simbarashe Kundizeza denies using AI to write prize-winning story
articles.description:
Article in Atlantic claims The Blue Fighter was artificially generated, days after it won Caine prize for African writers
The Zimbabwean writer Simbarashe Kundizeza has denied using AI to write a prize-winning short story after an article in the Atlantic said software had flagged it as almost completely AI-generated.
Kundizeza’s story The Blue Fighter was announced as the winner of the prestigious Caine prize for African writers on 6 October. Five days later, The Atlantic published an article by the author and journalist Vauhini Vara titled: “Yet Another Literary prize winner Seems to Be AI.”

articles.title: Guinea-Bissau denies it has approved controversial vaccine trial in newborns
articles.description:
Health minister says government ‘did not authorize’ Danish-led hepatitis B trial in babies backed by RFK Jr
Guinea-Bissau has not approved the controversial hepatitis B study in newborns that would be funded by the US government and private partners, the African country’s minister of health said on Tuesday.
The study, which would not investigate the safety or effectiveness of vaccines but would instead track “nonspecific” health outcomes like overall mortality or neurodevelopmental conditions, has been championed by Robert F Kennedy Jr, secretary of the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and a longtime anti-vaccine activist.

Brazil’s congress has approved a constitutional amendment to shorten the working week to a maximum of 40 hours, a move that could affect 30 million workers and that will hand a political victory to the leftist president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ahead of the presidential runoff in under two weeks.
In an attempt to overturn the first-round lead secured by his opponent, far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula has strongly championed the amendment, which will give some workers an extra day off each week.

articles.description: With few details so far, it is unclear what might need to change for a Pope who has been focused on stability.

articles.summary: 教皇のがん診断を受け、カトリック教徒の間で今後の教会の方向性について疑問が広がっている。詳細は不明で、安定を重視してきた教皇に何が必要となるかは不透明だ。

articles.title: Why Moscow is staying tight-lipped on Trump's energy ceasefire
articles.description: While Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky suggests he would sign up to a ceasefire on energy infrastructure, Russia has said little.
articles.titleJa: モスクワがトランプ氏のエネルギー停戦提案について沈黙を保つ理由

articles.title: Argentina targets UK in legal claim over Falklands oil exploration
articles.description: The action filed with an international maritime tribunal is the latest development in an escalating row over the Falkland Islands.
articles.titleJa: アルゼンチン、フォークランド諸島での石油探査をめぐり英国を提訴
articles.summary: フォークランド諸島をめぐるアルゼンチンと英国間の係争が激化。国際海洋裁判所に提訴され、石油探査に関する新たな展開を見せている。

articles.title: Mexican gang kidnaps officials to force detained member's release
articles.description: The gang seized the officials shortly after a high-ranking member was detained, demanding he be released.
articles.titleJa: メキシコのギャング、拘束されたメンバーの釈放を求め当局者を誘拐
articles.summary: メキシコのギャングが幹部の拘束を受け、その釈放を要求して当局者を誘拐した。

articles.title: US detains man accused in multi-billion Venezuelan money laundering scheme
articles.description: US officials had been offering a reward of $10m (£7.5m) for information leading to Álvaro Pulido's arrest.
articles.titleJa: 米国、数百万ドル規模のベネズエラ資金洗浄計画に関与した男を拘束
articles.summary: 米国当局は、ベネズエラの数百万ドル規模の資金洗浄計画で告発されたアルバロ・プリードを拘束。逮捕に繋がる情報には1000万ドルの懸賞金がかけられていた。

articles.title: Powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake hits Panama, damaging buildings
articles.description: Tsunami warnings are issued for neighbouring countries as videos of destruction circulate online.

articles.summary: パナマでマグニチュード7.7の強力な地震が発生し、建物が損傷した。近隣諸国に津波警報が発令されている。

articles.title: Three men found guilty of murdering two Australian surfer brothers and US friend in Mexico

articles.description: El Niño has continued to strengthen, with several key measures now in record territory. Simon King explores how it compares to previous events.
articles.titleJa: スーパーエルニーニョ、前例のないレベルに強化され新たな記録を樹立
articles.summary: エルニーニョ現象が強化され続け、複数の主要な指標が記録的な領域に達した。過去のイベントと比較し、その影響が探られている。

articles.titleJa: 映画がウィンドラッシュ世代の子どもたちの「豊かな人生のタペストリー」を共有
articles.summary: ウィンドラッシュ世代の親を持つ7人の物語が新作映画で描かれ、彼らの多様な人生経験が共有されている。

articles.title: The small African nation ready for Messi's big night

articles.title: Owner, businessman & player: Messi has big plans as a golden era ends

articles.title: How the trial of murdered Australian brothers and US friend unfolded
articles.description: The mother of two Australian surfers murdered in Mexico two years ago with their American friend said "accountability matters".
articles.titleJa: 殺害されたオーストラリア人兄弟と米国人友人の裁判がいかに展開したか

articles.title: How authoritarian states are building an international market for digital surveillance
articles.description: Digital authoritarianism is not developing in isolation, but through the international exchange of technologies, standards, and practices.
articles.titleJa: 権威主義国家がいかにしてデジタル監視の国際市場を構築しているか
articles.summary: 権威主義国家は、デジタル監視技術、標準、実践の国際的な交換を通じて、デジタル監視の国際市場を形成しています。これは国際政治と社会に広範な影響を与えます。

articles.title: How Ecuador is fighting to keep industrial trans fats off the food shelf
articles.description: As health advocates push for tighter controls, Ecuador confronts the gap between regulating trans fats and enforcing those rules.
articles.titleJa: エクアドルはいかにして工業用トランス脂肪酸を食品棚からなくそうと戦っているか
articles.summary: エクアドルは、健康推進団体による厳格な管理要求に対し、トランス脂肪酸規制と施行のギャップに直面しています。これは国民の健康を守るための重要な取り組みです。

articles.title: Trump’s ‘Agreements on Reciprocal Trade’ (ARTs) threaten equitable access to the internet in Global South
articles.description: The controversial reciprocal trade agreements (ARTs) gives the U.S. a great deal of power, which could adversely affect digital connectivity, increase digital divides, and reduce economic growth in signatory countries.

articles.title: El Niño speeds climate crisis and tests Latin America’s food security
articles.description: From droughts to floods and fires, El Niño is exposing vulnerabilities in Latin America’s food systems by putting farmers, food supplies and household budgets under growing pressure across the region.
articles.titleJa: エルニーニョが気候危機を加速させ、ラテンアメリカの食料安全保障を試す
articles.summary: エルニーニョ現象は、干ばつ、洪水、火災を通じてラテンアメリカの食料システムにおける脆弱性を露呈させ、農民、食料供給、家計に深刻な圧力をかけています。

articles.title: Young people are bridging the climate divide for Oceania and the Caribbean

articles.titleJa: 若者たちがオセアニアとカリブ海地域の気候格差を埋める
articles.summary: 強固で一貫した気候政策の欠如により、オセアニアとカリブ海地域では気候関連災害で毎年多くの人々が大切なものを失っています。若者たちがこの問題に橋を架けています。

articles.title: In Brazil’s capital, residents grow their own heat-fighting solutions
articles.description: Life in the favelas surrounding Brazil’s capital brings the health risks of extreme heat — a symptom of the global inequities of green space access
articles.titleJa: ブラジルの首都で、住民が熱波対策の解決策を自ら育てる
articles.summary: ブラジルの首都周辺のファベーラでは、極度の暑さによる健康リスクに直面しており、住民は緑地アクセスにおける世界的不平等の症状として、独自の熱対策を実践しています。

articles.title: Equating protest with terrorism: A narrative against dissent

articles.summary: 米国や他国の指導者たちが、抗議活動をテロリズムと同一視することで異議申し立てを非正当化する物語について深く掘り下げます。これは民主主義に影響を与えます。

articles.title: The commodification of Indigenous cultures and traditions

articles.summary: 先住民文化と伝統が商品化され、その資源や意味がコミュニティから外部へ流れ出し、何世紀にもわたり彼らを抑圧してきた外部の人々を富ませている問題について解説します。

articles.title: Ecuador detains former minister José Serrano after U.S. deportation

articles.titleJa: エクアドル、米国から強制送還された元大臣ホセ・セラーノを拘束
articles.summary: 米国から強制送還されたエクアドルの元大臣ホセ・セラーノが、重大な刑事捜査と政治的告発に直面。公正な法的手続きに疑問が呈される中、同国の司法制度が試されています。

articles.summary: ブラジルのアウウェ・シャバンテ民族は、巨大鉄道プロジェクトの影響を非難し、領土、自己決定、そして生きる権利の尊重を求める先住民主導のキャンペーンを展開しています。

articles.title: Desperate to clear toxic haze, Indonesia douses its skies with dry ice
articles.description: Authorities in South East Asia have turned to weather modification as fires blanket the region in smog.

articles.title: What if you could turn off your algorithm? Australia is about to try

articles.summary: オーストラリア議会で、巨大テクノロジー企業に対しユーザーがレコメンドアルゴリズムを停止できるように強制する新法案が提出され、デジタルプライバシーの選択肢を拡大する動きが始まる。

articles.title: Australia's first-ever Michelin stars go to 11 restaurants in one state

articles.titleJa: オーストラリア初のミシュランの星、ある州の11店舗に
articles.summary: オーストラリアで初のミシュランの星が南オーストラリア州の11店舗に授与された。州政府が覆面調査員の費用を負担したことがその理由と報じられている。

articles.title: India's 'cockroach' leaders jailed after holding protest

articles.summary: インドの若き指導者たちが、現在非公認となっている抗議サイト「ジャンタル・マンタル」での不法侵入容疑で拘留された。これは政治的抗議に対する取り締まりを浮き彫りにする。

articles.title: 'I'd talk to the TV': The paid companions bringing warmth to China's lonely
articles.description: As loneliness grows in China, a new industry is emerging to provide companionship and support.

articles.summary: 中国で孤独が深まる中、話し相手やサポートを提供する新しい産業が台頭している。これは社会的なつながりを求める人々に心の温かさをもたらすサービスだ。

articles.title: Watch: Hong Kong crowds queue to see Van Gogh painting unveiled for first time in 60 years

articles.summary: ゴッホの「花咲くマロニエ」が60年ぶりに公開され、香港では大勢の人々が鑑賞のために列を作っている。この絵画は週末のオークションで記録的な入札が予想されている。

articles.title: Who's to blame for the toxic haze choking South East Asia?

articles.title: Why the lonely in China are hiring 'temporary children'
articles.description: A new industry being dubbed the “loneliness economy” has emerged in China, with people hiring themselves out as companions to help the elderly.

articles.title: The island where locals say data centres are taking their water

articles.titleJa: データセンターが水を奪っていると住民が語る島
articles.summary: ある島では、データセンターの建設・運営により地元住民の水道が3ヶ月間も止まっていると報じられている。産業発展と地域社会の資源問題が浮き彫りになっている。

articles.title: Boardroom feud tests trusted Indian business empire
articles.description: The dispute raises questions about the Indian conglomerate's governance, succession plans and future.
articles.titleJa: 役員会での確執がインドの信頼される事業帝国を試す
articles.summary: インドの信頼される複合企業で役員会での確執が表面化し、そのガバナンス、後継者計画、そして将来性について疑問が投げかけられている。これはインド経済にも影響を与えうる問題だ。

articles.title: Madagascar launches safeguard investigation on certain confectionary
articles.description: On 12 October 2026, Madagascar notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated on 9 October 2026 a safeguard investigation on imports of sugar confectionary as well as chocolate and cocoa confectionary.
articles.titleJa: マダガスカル、特定の菓子類に対するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: マダガスカルは、砂糖、チョコレート、ココア菓子類の輸入に対するセーフガード調査を2026年10月9日に開始したとWTOに通知した。

articles.title: AI boom and trade resilience to Middle East crisis lift outlook, but gains to be uneven
articles.description: Global trade proved more resilient than expected in the first half of 2026 despite the disruption caused by the Middle East conflict, as supply chains adapted and strong investment in artificial intelligence provided a powerful boost to goods trade. However, the resilience was not uniform, with services trade and some regions more exposed to the effects of the conflict. WTO economists have therefore raised the forecast for merchandise trade growth in 2026 while lowering the outlook for services trade.
articles.titleJa: AIブームと中東危機への貿易の回復力が経済見通しを押し上げるが、利益は不均一に
articles.summary: 2026年上半期の世界貿易は、中東紛争にもかかわらずAI投資とサプライチェーンの適応により回復力を示した。WTOは商品貿易予測を上方修正したが、サービス貿易見通しは下方修正し、利益の不均一性を指摘。

articles.title: Services bodies spotlight Public Forum, remittance costs and development issues
articles.description: At meetings held from 7 to 9 October, the WTO Council for Trade in Services and the Committee on Trade in Financial Services commended the fruitful discussions on services trade at the 2026 Public Forum, continued discussions on transparency of measures regarding recognition of foreign service suppliers' qualifications, and exchanged views on how to reinvigorate the Council's work. Members also addressed how to facilitate digital payment systems and reduce the cost of remittances, help least-developed countries (LDCs) strengthen their participation in services trade, and various trade concerns.
articles.titleJa: サービス機関が公開フォーラム、送金費用、開発問題に注目
articles.summary: WTOサービス貿易理事会は、公開フォーラムでの議論を評価し、外国サービス提供者の資格認定の透明性、デジタル決済、送金費用、後発開発途上国の貿易参加促進について意見交換した。

articles.title: Rules of Origin Committee reviews LDC preferences, shares best practices
articles.description: The WTO Committee on Rules of Origin (CRO) met on 7-8 October to review developments in preferential rules of origin for least-developed countries (LDCs), hear updates from preference-granting members, and exchange experiences on origin administration and trade facilitation. Members also examined notifications on non-preferential rules of origin, discussed digital tools that can improve transparency and compliance with origin requirements, and considered draft annual reports on the Committee's work.
articles.titleJa: 原産地規則委員会、LDC優遇措置を検討し、ベストプラクティスを共有
articles.summary: WTO原産地規則委員会は、後発開発途上国向けの優遇原産地規則の進展を検討し、デジタルツールの活用や行政のベストプラクティスについて意見を交換した。

articles.title: General Council addresses WTO reform, ministerial follow-ups, ongoing negotiations
articles.description: WTO members meeting at the General Council on 5-6 October addressed issues related to the ongoing discussions on WTO reform, follow-up to outcomes of past ministerial conferences, and the state of ongoing negotiations on various topics. Members also discussed issues related to the Agreement on Electronic Commerce, emerging agricultural trade issues, and optimizing the outcome of future ministerial conferences, among other issues.
articles.titleJa: 一般理事会、WTO改革、閣僚会議のフォローアップ、進行中の交渉について議論
articles.summary: WTO一般理事会は、WTO改革、過去の閣僚会議の成果のフォローアップ、電子商取引や農業に関する交渉の進捗状況など、重要な議題について議論を行った。

articles.title: Co-sponsors of sustainability initiative advance work plan towards MC15
articles.description: At a meeting on 2 October, co-sponsors of the Trade and Environmental Sustainability Structured Discussions (TESSD) discussed a work plan for 2026-27 in preparation for the 15th WTO Ministerial Conference (MC15). They identified priorities, working methods and potential deliverables for each work area, and expressed broad support for a transition towards more flexible and outcome-oriented work.
articles.titleJa: 持続可能性イニシアチブの共同提案者がMC15に向けた作業計画を進展
articles.summary: 貿易と環境持続可能性に関する構造化議論（TESSD）の共同提案者は、第15回WTO閣僚会議（MC15）に向けた2026-27年の作業計画を議論し、柔軟で成果志向の作業への移行を支持した。

articles.title: WTO MSME Group explores IP's role in trade, hears success stories and updates
articles.description: The Informal Working Group on Micro, Small and Medium-sized Enterprises (MSMEs) met on 2 October, with a focus on the practical role of intellectual property (IP) in helping small businesses innovate, grow and reach international markets. The meeting included an information session on IP tools and thematic presentations from members, international organizations and stakeholders. Several members reported on MSME initiatives in formal WTO committees.
articles.titleJa: WTO MSMEグループ、貿易における知的財産の役割を探る
articles.summary: WTO中小零細企業（MSME）非公式作業部会は、知的財産が中小企業の革新と国際市場への進出を支援する役割に焦点を当て、成功事例を共有した。

articles.title: DDG Nordquist: Trade continues apace, showing resiliency
articles.description: Speaking at a panel on leadership in global trade at the 17th Swiss Coffee Trade Association (SCTA) Forum on 1 October in Montreux, Deputy Director-General DJ Nordquist said that the WTO and its basic functions are increasingly important as geopolitics and economic security now play a much bigger role in trade decisions, with companies having to think more about geopolitical exposure, security of supply, regulatory risk and resilience.
articles.titleJa: ノルドクイスト事務次長：貿易は着実に続き、回復力を示している
articles.summary: ノルドクイストWTO事務次長は、地政学と経済安全保障が貿易に影響を与える中、WTOの重要性が高まっており、企業は地政学的リスクと供給の回復力を考慮する必要があると強調した。

articles.title: Director-General cites concerns with pace of negotiations as chairs report on state of play
articles.description: A meeting of the Trade Negotiations Committee (TNC) on 1 October provided WTO members with an opportunity to take stock of the WTO's negotiating agenda six months after the 14th Ministerial Conference (MC14) in Yaoundé and voice their views on how to advance their work. Members heard readouts from the chairs of the negotiating bodies about the state of play in their respective talks.
articles.titleJa: 事務局長、議長が交渉状況を報告する中で交渉ペースに懸念を示す
articles.summary: 貿易交渉委員会（TNC）の会合で、WTO事務局長はMC14後の交渉アジェンダの進捗状況に懸念を表明し、今後の作業の進め方について議論が行われた。

articles.title: Co-sponsors of Plastics Dialogue hold first round of technical discussions following MC14
articles.description: At a meeting on 1 October 2026, WTO members participating in the Dialogue on Plastics Pollution and Environmentally Sustainable Plastics Trade (DPP) held the first substantive round of discussions across four areas of work: circular solutions to plastics pollution; waste-management technologies; single-use plastics; and trade-related plastics measures. Building on the DPP's outcomes from the 14th Ministerial Conference (MC14) in March 2026 and earlier technical work, the discussions were aimed at moving towards more focused and practical work in the lead-up to MC15.
articles.titleJa: プラスチック対話の共同提案者がMC14後初の技術議論を開催
articles.summary: プラスチック汚染と環境に配慮したプラスチック貿易に関する対話（DPP）参加者は、MC14後初の技術議論を行い、プラスチック汚染の循環的解決策や貿易措置について話し合った。
